restricted_model_replay.environment: Existing isolated replay virtualenv plus separately installed no-dependency xgboost, numba and llvmlite in /dev/shm; user-site disabled. Local restricted source model and calibration explicitly provided.
restricted_model_replay.limitations: Not a clean-room rebuild from raw source data; not a complete install verification, model refit, data-rights resolution, independent sensor or climate validation.
